$comment: Architecture rules as checks (C-05, C-22, C-29, NFR-03). Paths follow the module-first layout of ADR-0003 (Accepted): src/modules/<module>/{domain,application,interface-adapters,frameworks} plus src/shared/ with the same four folders; a path segment '*' matches any one module. Update them in the same PR that changes that ADR. Rules whose folders do not exist yet are skipped.
